strings: Hello. I am here to drag the dead cats of c_n into the Dark Forest.
Growls at the thought of never fading.
Wonders if {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} could kill the cats {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}'s stuck with.
Is furious at the fact that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} has been dragged down to be a guide.
Scowls at the new cats {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}'s let into the Dark Forest.
Watches the Clans with a smirk.
Is revolted at the thought of joining StarClan.
Frowns when the medicine cat doesn't listen to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} 'prophecy.'
Smiles when the medicine cat fails to hear StarClans omen.
Stares across the Dark Forest border and into the shining fields of Starclan.
